```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)

set.seed(1)
```

```{r}
x_vec = rnorm(n=40, mean=12, sd=63)
(x_vec - mean(x_vec)) / sd(x_vec)
```

```{r}
z_score = function(x) {
  if (!is.numeric(x)) {
    stop("Input x must be numeric")
  } else if (length(x) < 5) {
    stop("x should have 5 or more")
  }
  z = (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)
  return (z)
}
```

```{r}
z_score(x_vec)
z_score(rpois(40, lambda=12))
```

```{r eval = FALSE}
z_score(c(TRUE, FALSE))
z_score(3)
```
